We gave this to our 6-year-old for Christmas to encourage more creative, screen-free time. It has exceeded our hopes. Not only is she captivated by making her own music, but we've noticed real improvements in her coordination as she uses both hands, her focus as she follows the practice sheets, and her rhythm as she tries to match tunes she hears. It's a toy that genuinely grows with her skills. As a gift, it was a huge hit—it looks beautiful, feels substantial (not like disposable plastic), and promotes such positive development. It’s the kind of present parents and grandparents love to give.

My 5-year-old daughter had tried my full-sized keyboard but got frustrated because her fingers couldn't comfortably reach the keys. This one is a game-changer! The spacing is perfect for her small hands, and she can finally press one key at a time without straining. The included note stickers and practice sheets were a genius addition. Within a week, she was proudly recognizing the notes and playing 'Twinkle Twinkle' all by herself. It built her confidence so quickly. It's clearly designed by people who understand how little kids actually learn.
Grandsons love these pianos. Love the record button. Grandsons record their music and then listen to their creations. Oh and they love the microphones.

This Montessori learning table is really cute and keeps little ones busy. It’s great for babies six months and up, with lots of fun things to touch, move and explore. There are several activities in one place, like a xylophone, mirror, gears, beat tracks, stacking pieces, carrot pull game and even a small fishing set. It helps keeps kids interested since they can switch between activities. The wood feels sturdy and well-made. The corners are smooth and rounded, and the table stay stable while they play. The legs can also be removed, which makes it easy to store. Overall, it’s a simple, fun learning table that makes a great gift and keeps little hands busy.

Our toddlers are absolutely obsessed with this table, and honestly, so are we. It has been a wonderful support as they learn to pull themselves up and find their footing, giving them something sturdy to hold while they build confidence standing. The variety of interactive pieces keeps little hands busy in the best way: sliding, grasping, and twisting with endless sensory feedback that they just can’t get enough of. There’s also real longevity built into the design, as the color and shape elements will grow with them as their skills develop. The solid wood construction is genuinely impressive; this is not a toy that wobbles or wears down. Everything is thoughtfully sized with no tiny pieces to worry about, and the center basket is a brilliant touch for keeping everything organized. A purchase we feel great about and I’m happy it was simple to assemble.

I am very impressed! Structure: It is the perfect height for a toddler, and sturdy during play. (I do recommend grips for the legs if using on carpet.) Activities: This has a fish pond and pole, a tray of logs that go in the holes in the center and in the garden, a colors and shapes set of blocks, alphabet letters written on the board, a little vegetable garden, matching game, loop activity, musical area, and a few more options! Practicality: I've used all the above with my 14 month old grandson, and he hadn't tired of it after a month of play. Assembly: Just screw in the legs! Super fast & easy. Safety: I would recommend it for children who are no longer putting everything in their mouth, but there do not appear to be any small parts that would cause concern under supervision for them anyway. I know he will play with this for a long time!

This is a great activity table for toddlers. The design and build quality are comparable with the one in my doctor's office waiting area. The wood is of good quality, with no splinters or rough edges. A lot of stability on four wooden legs. Very easy to assemble in a couple minutes. Large enough to have a lot of activities, but small enough to tuck into the corner of a room. Great value for the price.

The desk arrives dis-assembled. Assembly instructions were minimal leading to some questions regarding placement of the activity pieces. The rest of the assembly was installing the legs - don't use excessive force. The table is sized appropriately for little ones allowing full access to all the fun activities. One of the more popular activities was fishing. The Xylophone was another favorite. Once assembled, the table provides a safe, stable and durable toy that should last for quite some time. I waited a couple months to review this product to see if the kids still found the table fun and interesting. They still play with it regularly.

We bought this for our toddler, and it has been a huge hit. There are so many different activities packed onto one table that it really keeps their attention for more than just a few minutes. Pros: Variety: From the xylophone to the bead maze and the fishing game, there’s a great mix of sensory and motor skill activities. Aesthetic: The wooden design looks much nicer in our living room than a bunch of bright plastic toys. Sturdy: The table itself feels solid and stable enough for a little one to lean on while playing. Cons: Small Pieces: Some of the accessories (like the fish and carrots) are on the smaller side. If your child is still in a heavy "mouth everything" phase, you’ll definitely want to supervise closely. Storage: Because there are so many loose pieces, they tend to end up all over the floor. I wish there was a built-in storage net underneath to hold everything when not in use. Overall, it’s a fantastic Montessori-style toy that offers a lot of value for the price. Just keep an eye on the loose parts!

L' articolo è arrivato in tempi brevi e ben imballato. Mi ha sorpreso in positivo per la sua versatilità: ha una lavagnetta magnetica bifacciale, bianco/ scuro, è regolabile in altezza e in posizione, è corredato da un piano di appoggio per diversi accessori compresi, tipo pastelli a cera lavabili, pennarelli per lavagnetta magnetica, lettere e numeri magnetici e cancellini. È stato molto apprezzato e viene usato praticamente sempre. Bel prodotto con un rapporto qualità-prezzo ottimo. Consigliato.
